endorsedOutput.text:
We looked at attendance data across our hybrid client base this quarter, and the pattern surprised us.

Teams with a fixed two-day in-office schedule reported 18% [1] fewer scheduling conflicts than teams with fully flexible policies. The difference wasn't about enforcement — it was about predictability. When everyone knows Tuesday and Thursday are the anchor days, coordination stops being a weekly negotiation.

If your team is still negotiating its hybrid policy week to week, a fixed anchor-day structure might be worth testing before assuming full flexibility is the answer.
